findings.F1: The book is close to holding the coins. Its daily returns correlate 0.93 with holding them. Its mean position is 0.79 of the book, and it holds a position on 96 % of the coins' days. On the book's worst 2 % of days it loses 9.7 %, against 11.8 % for holding; on its best 2 % it gains 9.1 %, against 10.6 % for holding. Its Sharpe beats holding's by only 0.015, so what it earns is mostly the coins' own drift, not the down-streak timing.
findings.F2: The book's position falls as an up-close streak lengthens: 0.98 to 1.00 after 2 to 5 down closes, then 0.82 after 1 up close, 0.64 after 3 and 0.01 after 5 or more. The book therefore steps out of the market during long up streaks, because its forecast is zero after any up close.
findings.F3: On the 5-day grid, the streak length predicts no 5-day excess return. The slope over signed streak length is t 1.54 (3419 cases, 617 days). The slopes on the 1-, 5- and 20-day past return, the 20-day volatility and the day's range all have |t| below 0.9 (2843 to 3419 cases).
findings.F4: Grouped by streak length (from −5 to +5), the 5-day excess return has no consistent sign or grading. It is −0.92 % after 5+ down closes (t −0.42, 60 cases) and −4.25 % after 4 (t −2.61, 80 cases), but +1.41 % after 3 (t 1.31). On the up side it is +0.32 % after 5+ up closes (t 0.25). The one |t| above 2 sits among 11 groups and has no neighbouring group of the same sign.
findings.F5: Among about 60 groupings by streak, past-return quintile, volatility, range, weekday and year, the largest t's are modest and isolated. The 3-day return after 5+ up closes is +1.71 % (t 2.41, 131 cases) and after 4 is +1.08 % (t 1.31), yet the 5-day return after 5+ up closes is +0.32 % (t 0.25). The next-day return after a single up close is −0.32 % (t −2.68, 4681 cases), and Friday's next-day return is +0.30 % (t 2.09). The weekday groups swing sign from year to year: Monday–Tuesday ranges from −0.44 % to +0.34 %.
findings.F6: The size of the next day's move does not reliably grow with streak length. The absolute next-day return is +20.8 % above the coin's usual after 5 closes in the same direction (t 1.97, 404 cases) and +12.6 % after 6+ (t 1.61). Over 5 days it is −18.6 % after 6+ (t −1.85), the opposite way.

no_ideas: The streak length, the past returns, the volatility, the range, the weekday, the year and the book's extreme days all leave no pattern that stands out. Across about 60 groupings the best t's are 2.0 to 2.7, isolated and not graded (F3–F6). The book's profit is the coins' drift held 96 % of the time (F1, F2), not a new effect.
